name: Stripe - Webhook di Pagamento
description: Notifiche webhook server-to-server inviate dai server Stripe con User-Agent ufficiale in formato POST.
expression: http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.user_agent, "Stripe/") and (http.request.uri.path contains "stripe" or http.request.uri.query contains "stripe")
note: Webhook ufficiali Stripe (POST con User-Agent Stripe/)
